citation: Papagiannopoulos-Vatopaidinos I, et al. Metabolism Open 2025;26:100363
protocol: 5-day dry fast (no food or water), blood drawn daily at the end of each 20:00-to-20:00 day interval: days 0, 2, 3, 5 tabulated
population: 10 participants (3 M, 7 F), mean age 49.5 (30-65), BMI 29.5 (20-39), normal glucose metabolism, recruited from a fasting-therapy practice
note: Dry fasting (no water) so hydration stress differs from water fasts; table prints SE with SD in parentheses; some columns are changes from day 0, not absolute values.
